Account control

Data Deletion

You can disconnect Chikku Publisher and request deletion of associated account data at any time.

Remove platform access

  1. Open the connected platform’s account settings and locate authorised apps, websites or business integrations.
  2. Select Chikku Publisher and remove or revoke its access.
  3. Delete locally stored credentials and publishing history from the Chikku server, or ask the server administrator to do so.

Request deletion by email

Email mmyshortstories@gmail.com with the subject Chikku data deletion request. Include the platform and public username or Page name associated with the request. Do not send passwords or access tokens.

We will acknowledge the request and delete account identifiers, stored authorisation data and service-side publishing records under our control within 30 days, unless retention is required for security or legal obligations.

Important: Removing data from Chikku does not automatically delete posts already published to Facebook, Instagram, Threads or YouTube. Delete those posts from the relevant platform directly.

Confirmation

When the request is complete, confirmation will be sent to the email address used for the request. Platform access can also be revoked immediately without waiting for confirmation.
